title: Exploring Cross-Image Pixel Contrast for Semantic Segmentation
mechanism: Supervised pixel-to-pixel and pixel-to-region contrast across images using class memory banks.
adaptation: Cross-source memory bank pulls BMRK / CFVS / CSIR crack embeddings together (source invariance for weak sources); full-res projection head. Run this or ReCo, not both.
min_experiment: Arm: contrast loss weight 0.1, 3 seeds; baseline SUP100; metric per-source crack IoU (BMRK) and mIoU_rob; kill if BMRK crack gain < 0.02 and mIoU_rob n.d.
evidence: R: gains on Cityscapes and other benchmarks with DeepLabV3 and HRNet (abstract level).
